data_fields.name: zone_start_leeway_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 150 (floor on the zone timer at zone start)

best_idea: Keep one expiry time per party instance that both the world sweep and the zone timer read, delete an instance only when no zone has anyone in it, and give a removed member a kick delay instead of an instant kick.
decision_why: The party roster, single expiry, leader hand-over with cooldown and removal-kick delay fit zones-as-data and per-party state; the donor's empty-grace branch never holds the instance (defect fixed in the sketch), the lockout multiplier is applied to some writes only, and the zone start floor clamps the expiry; GPL-3.0-or-later so clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test: a party of three leaves an instance with no one inside; the instance survives the empty grace (1500 s by default) and is deleted only after it passes with no players in any zone; a member removed while inside is kicked to safe return 60 s later unless re-added in that window.
